description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 12.02.2018 to 18.02.2018
categorisation: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and concerns the determination of official exchange rates for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, specifically addressing compliance requirements for calculating import/export duties. The content involves statutory instruments and regulatory procedures rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
